html:
Vietnam is a communist state on the eastern coast of mainland Southeast Asia, shown on the map from 1960, when it was still split into a northern and a southern state.

Ho Chi Minh declared independence from France in 1945. The war that followed ended with the French defeat at Dien Bien Phu in 1954, and the Geneva conference divided the country at the 17th parallel. The communist North, which carried out a harsh land reform, backed a guerrilla war in the South, supplied along the Ho Chi Minh trail. The United States sent troops to defend the South, and the Vietnam War became one of the largest conflicts of the Cold War.

Saigon fell in 1975 and the country was reunited in 1976. Hundreds of thousands left as boat people. Vietnam invaded Cambodia in 1978 to remove the Khmer Rouge, and China attacked its northern border in 1979. In 1986 the party launched the Doi Moi reforms, opening the economy to markets while keeping one-party rule. Vietnam joined ASEAN in 1995 and became a large exporter of rice, coffee and electronics.
sum: Vietnam is a communist state on the eastern coast of mainland Southeast Asia, shown on the map from 1960, when it was still split into a northern and a southern state.
